bias: Hot CPI, volume finally came back — to the sell side (SPY more than double Tuesday, ES nearly double). The top trade on the board worked exactly as written: NQ's Asia rally topped at 883-906, LAAF of 815-845, same again on CPI, and NQ completed its move to 30216.5 and tested its bullish RTH gap. ES opened on a true gap down, failed to reclaim Tuesday's low into 38-40, and it was lights out after the IB low 7800 was defended from below; the red box broke down and today's low filled the 10/1→10/2 bullish gap. Not violent — controlled, persistent selling that left limited structure. Liquidations of longs are ultimately bullish once complete, but he's 'in no mood to try to pick a bottom until presented with a proper setup.' Prefers trading lower first and failing before a relief rally; keeps an open mind for an immediate one.
wildcard: Thin structure cuts both ways: if an upside reversal takes hold it can retrace more readily than a volume-built sell — 'we could be down 50 or up 50 and I don't think anyone would be surprised.' A direct continuation without volume build makes the eventual relief rally ferocious; building volume and then going lower is the more bearish path. At the time of writing NQ had already taken out today's low in ETH and was testing 932-969, so his NQ shorts get a mental downgrade (traded lower first). His lean: he'd like to see the NQ RTH gap filled at 29937.75 (932-969); acceptance below is suboptimal — structure is thin to the 29760s. QQQ 721.73-724.16 ≈ NQ 29885-29986.

brief.higher: Tricky after a day like this. Any fail in 7780-84 can rotate back to 7747-54 (not super clean). 7780-84 → 7800-02 probably makes it; a defense at 7800-02 needs a fresh loss of 80-84 and probably 7771 for sellers to reassert. Above 7800-02 is clean to ~7810 but really 15-20 — a 'must defend' for sellers, with some supply above that could trigger a failed reclaim. A session uptrend that looks like a 'structure repair mission' is OK for a tight-leash long.

If a LBAF of today's low is active, a 216.5 reclaim gets interesting; then monitor weekly levels up to the daily 440-454. Anything below 504-546, especially 369-391, can be bearish consolidation: tight leash on longs, join any session downtrend short.
